title: Half-Pint Jackson and leaving Chicago in 1920
summary: A question about Frankie Half-Pint Jackson, then Garland gives 1920 as when he left Chicago with the Oliver band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Did you hear of someone called Frankie Half-Pint Jackson, did you know him? Who? Half-Pint Jackson in Chicago, an entertainer, dancer.
Yeah. He was known as Half-Pint Jackson. Oh, Half-Pint. When did you leave Chicago?
Yeah. With all of his band. Yeah. And then what happened? Where'd you go?
